anomalies.observed: The potentiometer J5 pin 3 is wired to GND and simultaneously carries the NET0003 label. NET0003 also connects to U1 pin 1 (RESET/PB5), U4 pin 1 (RESET/PB5), and J2 pin 6 (RST) of the ISP header. Thus the MCU reset line is tied directly to ground.
anomalies.expected: Pin 3 of the pot should be GND only; the RESET/RST net (NET0003) must remain a separate node so the MCU can run and the programmer can drive reset.

evidence.quote: J5 POT: 1→+5V, 2→NET0010, 3→GND with NET0003 on the same wire at pin 3 (sheet /)
U1 pin 1 → NET0003; U4 pin 1 → NET0003; J2 pin 6 RST → NET0003

anomalies.impact: MCU held in permanent reset — board does not boot or respond to programming.

anomalies.observed: Q1 (BC817) collector (pin 3) is wired to Q2 drain (pin 3), which is the switched fan-supply node VCC_OUT feeding J9 pin 2; the same node also carries NET0005 (the TACH line at J9 pin 3). Q1's emitter is GND and its base is driven from NET0006 via R5.
anomalies.expected: In a high-side P-FET driver the NPN collector belongs on Q2's gate (pin 1); the fan supply (VCC_OUT) and the TACH feedback (NET0005) must be distinct nets, and no transistor should short the supply rail to ground.
anomalies.impact: Driving NET0006 low/high shorts the regulated fan rail to ground through Q1 and merges the PWM/feedback path into the supply; fan cannot be powered or speed-controlled correctly.

anomalies.observed: The two alternative MCU footprints disagree on PB3/PB4: U1 (ATtiny45) maps PB3(pin2)→NET0010 and PB4(pin3)→NET0008, while U4 (ATtiny13V) maps PB4(pin3)→NET0010 and PB3(pin2)→NET0008.
anomalies.expected: Interchangeable THT/SMD footprints must present an identical pin-to-net map so one layout/firmware works for either part.

evidence.quote: U1 right side: 2→NET0010, 3→NET0008; U4 right side: 3→NET0010, 2→NET0008

anomalies.impact: Whichever footprint is populated gets the pot-sense and clamped signals on opposite GPIOs, breaking firmware portability between the two builds.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: the RESET/RST net (NET0003) is merged with GND at the potentiometer's third terminal, holding the MCU in permanent reset, and the fan driver shows further deviations (NPN collector on the P-FET drain/supply node rather than its gate, and inconsistent PB3/PB4 mapping between the two MCU footprints).
